verses.a: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies
verses.b: for they are ever with me.

verses.a: I have more understanding than my teachers
verses.b: for thy testimonies are my study.

verses.a: I am wiser than the aged
verses.b: because I keep thy commandments.

verses.a: I have refrained my feet from every evil way
verses.b: that I may keep thy word.

verses.a: I have not shrunk from thy judgements
verses.b: for thou teachest me.

verses.a: O how sweet are thy words unto my throat
verses.b: yea, sweeter than honey unto my mouth.

verses.a: Through thy commandments I get understanding
verses.b: therefore I hate all evil ways.

verses.a: Thy word is a lantern unto my feet
verses.b: and a light unto my paths.

verses.a: I have sworn, and am stedfastly purposed
verses.b: to keep thy righteous judgements.

verses.a: I am troubled above measure
verses.b: quicken me, O Lord, according to thy word.

verses.a: Let the free-will offerings of my mouth please thee, O Lord
verses.b: and teach me thy judgements.

verses.a: My soul is alway in my hand
verses.b: yet do I not forget thy law.

verses.a: The ungodly have laid a snare for me
verses.b: but yet I swerved not from thy commandments.

verses.a: Thy testimonies have I claimed as mine heritage for ever
verses.b: and why? they are the very joy of my heart.

verses.a: I have applied my heart to fulfil thy statutes alway
verses.b: even unto the end.

verses.a: I hate them that imagine evil things
verses.b: but thy law do I love.

verses.a: Thou art my defence and shield
verses.b: and my trust is in thy word.

verses.a: Away from me, ye wicked
verses.b: I will keep the commandments of my God.

verses.a: O stablish me according to thy word, that I may live
verses.b: and let me not be disappointed of my hope.

verses.a: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe
verses.b: yea, my delight shall be ever in thy statutes.

verses.a: Thou hast trodden down all them that depart from thy statutes
verses.b: for they imagine but deceit.

verses.a: Thou puttest away all the ungodly of the earth like dross
verses.b: therefore I love thy testimonies.

verses.a: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee
verses.b: and I am afraid of thy judgements.

verses.a: I deal with the thing that is lawful and right
verses.b: O give me not over unto mine oppressors.

verses.a: Make thou thy servant to delight in that which is good
verses.b: that the proud do me no wrong.

verses.a: Mine eyes are wasted away with looking for thy health
verses.b: and for the word of thy righteousness.

verses.a: O deal with thy servant according unto thy loving mercy
verses.b: and teach me thy statutes.

verses.a: I am thy servant, O grant me understanding
verses.b: that I may know thy testimonies.

verses.a: It is time for thee, Lord, to lay to thine hand
verses.b: for they have destroyed thy law.

verses.a: For I love thy commandments
verses.b: above gold and precious stone.

verses.a: Therefore hold I straight all thy commandments
verses.b: and all false ways I utterly abhor.

verses.a: Thy testimonies are wonderful
verses.b: therefore doth my soul keep them.

verses.a: When thy word goeth forth
verses.b: it giveth light and understanding unto the simple.

verses.a: I opened my mouth, and drew in my breath
verses.b: for my delight was in thy commandments.

verses.a: O look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me
verses.b: as thou usest to do unto those that love thy Name.

verses.a: Order my steps in thy word
verses.b: and so shall no wickedness have dominion over me.

verses.a: O deliver me from the wrongful dealings of men
verses.b: and so shall I keep thy commandments.

verses.a: Shew the light of thy countenance upon thy servant
verses.b: and teach me thy statutes.

verses.a: Mine eyes gush out with water
verses.b: because men keep not thy law.

verses.a: Righteous art thou, O Lord
verses.b: and true is thy judgement.

verses.a: The testimonies that thou hast commanded
verses.b: are exceeding righteous and true.

verses.a: My zeal hath even consumed me
verses.b: because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.

verses.a: Thy word is tried to the uttermost
verses.b: and thy servant loveth it.

verses.a: I am small, and of no reputation
verses.b: yet do I not forget thy commandments.

verses.a: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness
verses.b: and thy law is the truth.

verses.a: Trouble and heaviness have taken hold upon me
verses.b: yet is my delight in thy commandments.

verses.a: The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting
verses.b: O grant me understanding, and I shall live.

verses.a: I call with my whole heart
verses.b: hear me, O Lord, I will keep thy statutes.

verses.a: Yea, even unto thee do I call
verses.b: help me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.

verses.a: Early in the morning do I cry unto thee
verses.b: for in thy word is my trust.

verses.a: Mine eyes prevent the night-watches
verses.b: that I might be occupied in thy words.

verses.a: Hear my voice, O Lord, according unto thy loving-kindness
verses.b: quicken me, according as thou art wont.

verses.a: They draw nigh that of malice persecute me
verses.b: and are far from thy law.

verses.a: Be thou nigh at hand, O Lord
verses.b: for all thy commandments are true.

verses.a: As concerning thy testimonies, I have known long since
verses.b: that thou hast grounded them for ever.

verses.a: O consider mine adversity, and deliver me
verses.b: for I do not forget thy law.

verses.a: Avenge thou my cause, and deliver me
verses.b: quicken me, according to thy word.

verses.a: Health is far from the ungodly
verses.b: for they regard not thy statutes.

verses.a: Great is thy mercy, O Lord
verses.b: quicken me, as thou art wont.

verses.a: Many there are that trouble me, and persecute me
verses.b: yet do I not swerve from thy testimonies.

verses.a: It grieveth me when I see the transgressors
verses.b: because they keep not thy law.

verses.a: Consider, O Lord, how I love thy commandments
verses.b: O quicken me, according to thy loving-kindness.

verses.a: Thy word is true from everlasting
verses.b: all the judgements of thy righteousness endure for evermore.

verses.a: Princes have persecuted me without a cause
verses.b: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.

verses.a: I am as glad of thy word
verses.b: as one that findeth great spoils.

verses.a: As for lies, I hate and abhor them
verses.b: but thy law do I love.

verses.a: Seven times a day do I praise thee
verses.b: because of thy righteous judgements.

verses.a: Great is the peace that they have who love thy law
verses.b: and they are not offended at it.

verses.a: Lord, I have looked for thy saving health
verses.b: and done after thy commandments.

verses.a: My soul hath kept thy testimonies
verses.b: and loved them exceedingly.

verses.a: I have kept thy commandments and testimonies
verses.b: for all my ways are before thee.

verses.a: Let my complaint come before thee, O Lord
verses.b: give me understanding, according to thy word.

verses.a: Let my supplication come before thee
verses.b: deliver me, according to thy word.

verses.a: My lips shall speak of thy praise
verses.b: when thou hast taught me thy statutes.

verses.a: Yea, my tongue shall sing of thy word
verses.b: for all thy commandments are righteous.

verses.a: Let thine hand help me
verses.b: for I have chosen thy commandments.

verses.a: I have longed for thy saving health, O Lord
verses.b: and in thy law is my delight.

verses.a: O let my soul live, and it shall praise thee
verses.b: and thy judgements shall help me.

verses.a: I have gone astray like a sheep that is lost
verses.b: O seek thy servant, for I do not forget thy commandments.

verses.a: When i was in trouble I called upon the Lord
verses.b: and he heard me.

verses.a: Deliver my soul, O Lord, from lying lips
verses.b: and from a deceitful tongue.

verses.a: What reward shall be given or done unto thee, thou false tongue
verses.b: even mighty and sharp arrows, with hot burning coals.

verses.a: Woe is me, that I am constrained to dwell with Mesech
verses.b: and to have my habitation among the tents of Kedar.

verses.a: My soul hath long dwelt among them
verses.b: that are enemies unto peace.

verses.a: I labour for peace, but when I speak unto them thereof
verses.b: they make them ready to battle.

verses.a: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills
verses.b: from whence cometh my help.

verses.a: My help cometh even from the Lord
verses.b: who hath made heaven and earth.

verses.a: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved
verses.b: and he that keepeth thee will not sleep.

verses.a: Behold, he that keepeth Israel
verses.b: shall neither slumber nor sleep.

verses.a: The Lord himself is thy keeper
verses.b: the Lord is thy defence upon thy right hand;

verses.a: So that the sun shall not burn thee by day
verses.b: neither the moon by night.

verses.a: The Lord shall preserve thee from all evil
verses.b: yea, it is even he that shall keep thy soul.

verses.a: The Lord shall preserve thy going out, and thy coming in
verses.b: from this time forth for evermore.

verses.a: I was glad when they said unto me
verses.b: We will go into the house of the Lord.

verses.a: Our feet shall stand in thy gates
verses.b: O Jerusalem.

verses.a: Jerusalem is built as a city
verses.b: that is at unity in itself.

verses.a: For thither the tribes go up, even the tribes of the Lord
verses.b: to testify unto Israel, to give thanks unto the Name of the Lord.

verses.a: For there is the seat of judgement
verses.b: even the seat of the house of David.

verses.a: O pray for the peace of Jerusalem
verses.b: they shall prosper that love thee.

verses.a: Peace be within thy walls
verses.b: and plenteousness within thy palaces.

verses.a: For my brethren and companions' sakes
verses.b: I will wish thee prosperity.

verses.a: Yea, because of the house of the Lord our God
verses.b: I will seek to do thee good.

verses.a: Unto thee lift I up mine eyes
verses.b: O thou that dwellest in the heavens.

verses.a: Behold, even as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress
verses.b: even so our eyes wait upon the Lord our God, until he have mercy upon us.

verses.a: Have mercy upon us, O Lord, have mercy upon us
verses.b: for we are utterly despised.

verses.a: Our soul is filled with the scornful reproof of the wealthy
verses.b: and with the despitefulness of the proud.

verses.a: If the Lord himself had not been on our side, now may Israel say
verses.b: if the Lord himself had not been on our side, when men rose up against us;

verses.a: They had swallowed us up quick
verses.b: when thy were so wrathfully displeased at us.

verses.a: Yea, the waters had drowned us
verses.b: and the stream had gone over our soul.

verses.a: The deep waters of the proud
verses.b: had gone even over our soul.

verses.a: But praised be the Lord
verses.b: who hath not given us over for a prey unto their teeth.

verses.a: Our soul is escaped even as a bird out of the snare of the fowler
verses.b: the snare is broken, and we are delivered .

verses.a: Our help standeth in the Name of the Lord
verses.b: who hath made heaven and earth.

verses.a: They that put their trust in the Lord shall be even as the mount Sion
verses.b: which may not be removed, but standeth fast for ever.

verses.a: The hills stand about Jerusalem
verses.b: even so standeth the Lord round about his people, from this time forth for evermore.

verses.a: For the rod of the ungodly cometh not into the lot of the righteous
verses.b: lest the righteous put their hand unto wickedness.

verses.a: Do well, O Lord
verses.b: unto those that are good and true of heart.

verses.a: As for such as turn back unto their own wickedness
verses.b: the Lord shall lead them forth with the evil-doers; but peace shall be upon Israel.

verses.a: When the Lord turned again the captivity of Sion
verses.b: then were we like unto them that dream.

verses.a: Then was our mouth filled with laughter
verses.b: and our tongue with joy.

verses.a: Then said they among the heathen
verses.b: The Lord hath done great things for them.

verses.a: Yea, the Lord hath done great things for us already
verses.b: whereof we rejoice.

verses.a: Turn our captivity, O Lord
verses.b: as the rivers in the south.

verses.a: They that sow in tears
verses.b: shall reap in joy.

verses.a: He that now goeth on his way weeping, and beareth forth good seed
verses.b: shall doubtless come again with joy, and bring his sheaves with him.

verses.a: Except the Lord build the house
verses.b: their labour is but lost that build it.

verses.a: Except the Lord keep the city
verses.b: the watchman waketh but in vain.

verses.a: It is but lost labour that ye haste to rise up early, and so late take rest, and eat the bread of carefulness
verses.b: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.

verses.a: Lo, children and the fruit of the womb
verses.b: are an heritage and gift that cometh of the Lord.

verses.a: Like as the arrows in the hand of the giant
verses.b: even so are the young children.

verses.a: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them
verses.b: they shall not be ashamed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.

verses.a: Blessed are all they that fear the Lord
verses.b: and walk in his ways.

verses.a: For thou shalt eat the labours of thine hands
verses.b: O well is thee, and happy shalt thou be.

verses.a: Thy wife shall be as the fruitful vine
verses.b: upon the walls of thine house.

verses.a: Thy children like the olive-branches
verses.b: round about thy table.

verses.a: Lo, thus shall the man be blessed
verses.b: that feareth the Lord.

verses.a: The Lord from out of Sion shall so bless thee
verses.b: that thou shalt see Jerusalem in prosperity all thy life long.

verses.a: Yea, that thou shalt see thy children's children
verses.b: and peace upon Israel.

verses.a: Many a time have they fought against me from my youth up
verses.b: may Israel now say.

verses.a: Yea, many a time have they vexed me from my youth up
verses.b: but they have not prevailed against me.

verses.a: The plowers plowed upon my back
verses.b: and made long furrows.

verses.a: But the righteous Lord
verses.b: hath hewn the snares of the ungodly in pieces.

verses.a: Let them be confounded and turned backward
verses.b: as many as have evil will at Sion.

verses.a: Let them be even as the grass growing upon the house-tops
verses.b: which withereth afore it be plucked up;

verses.a: Whereof the mower filleth not his hand
verses.b: neither he that bindeth up the sheaves his bosom.

verses.a: So that they who go by say not so much as, The Lord prosper you
verses.b: we wish you good luck in the Name of the Lord.

verses.a: Out of the deep have I called unto thee, O Lord
verses.b: Lord, hear my voice.

verses.a: O let thine ears consider well
verses.b: the voice of my complaint.

verses.a: If thou, Lord, wilt be extreme to mark what is done amiss
verses.b: O Lord, who may abide it?

verses.a: For there is mercy with thee
verses.b: therefore shalt thou be feared.

verses.a: I look for the Lord; my soul doth wait for him
verses.b: in his word is my trust.

verses.a: My soul fleeth unto the Lord
verses.b: before the morning watch, I say, before the morning watch.

verses.a: O Israel, trust in the Lord, for with the Lord there is mercy
verses.b: and with him is plenteous redemption.

verses.a: And he shall redeem Israel
verses.b: from all his sins.

verses.a: Lord, I am not high-minded
verses.b: I have no proud looks.

verses.a: I do not exercise myself in great matters
verses.b: which are too high for me.

verses.a: But I refrain my soul, and keep it low, like as a child that is weaned from his mother
verses.b: yea, my soul is even as a weaned child.

verses.a: O Israel, trust in the Lord
verses.b: from this time forth for evermore.

verses.a: Lord, remember David
verses.b: and all his trouble;

verses.a: How he sware unto the Lord
verses.b: and vowed a vow unto the Almighty God of Jacob;

verses.a: I will not come within the tabernacle of mine house
verses.b: nor climb up into my bed;

verses.a: I will not suffer mine eyes to sleep, nor mine eye-lids to slumber
verses.b: neither the temples of my head to take any rest;

verses.a: Until I find out a place for the temple of the Lord
verses.b: an habitation for the mighty God of Jacob.

verses.a: Lo, we heard of the same at Ephrata
verses.b: and found it in the wood.

verses.a: We will go into his tabernacle
verses.b: and fall low on our knees before his footstool.

verses.a: Arise, O Lord, into thy resting-place
verses.b: thou, and the ark of thy strength.

verses.a: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness
verses.b: and let thy saints sing with joyfulness.

verses.a: For thy servant David's sake
verses.b: turn not away the presence of thine Anointed.

verses.a: The Lord hath made a faithful oath unto David
verses.b: and he shall not shrink from it;

verses.a: Of the fruit of thy body
verses.b: shall I set upon thy seat.

verses.a: If thy children will keep my covenant, and my testimonies that I shall learn them
verses.b: their children also shall sit upon thy seat for evermore.

verses.a: For the Lord hath chosen Sion to be an habitation for himself
verses.b: he hath longed for her.

verses.a: This shall be my rest for ever
verses.b: here will I dwell, for I have a delight therein.

verses.a: I will bless her victuals with increase
verses.b: and will satisfy her poor with bread.

verses.a: I will deck her priests with health
verses.b: and her saints shall rejoice and sing.

verses.a: There shall I make the horn of David to flourish
verses.b: I have ordained a lantern for mine Anointed.

verses.a: As for his enemies, I shall clothe them with shame
verses.b: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.

verses.a: Behold, how good and joyful a thing it is
verses.b: brethren, to dwell together in unity!

verses.a: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down unto the beard
verses.b: even unto Aaron's beard, and went down to the skirts of his clothing.

verses.a: Like as the dew of Hermon
verses.b: which fell upon the hill of Sion.

verses.a: For there the Lord promised his blessing
verses.b: and life for evermore.

verses.a: Behold now, praise the Lord
verses.b: all ye servants of the Lord;

verses.a: Ye that by night stand in the house of the Lord
verses.b: even in the courts of the house of our God.

verses.a: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary
verses.b: and praise the Lord.

verses.a: The Lord that made heaven and earth
verses.b: give thee blessing out of Sion.

verses.a: O praise the Lord, laud ye the Name of the Lord
verses.b: praise it, O ye servants of the Lord;

verses.a: Ye that stand in the house of the Lord
verses.b: in the courts of the house of our God.

verses.a: O praise the Lord, for the Lord is gracious
verses.b: O sing praises unto his Name, for it is lovely.

verses.a: For why? the Lord hath chosen Jacob unto himself
verses.b: and Israel for his own possession.

verses.a: For I know that the Lord is great
verses.b: and that our Lord is above all gods.

verses.a: Whatsoever the Lord pleased, that did he in heaven and in earth
verses.b: and in the sea, and in all deep places.

verses.a: He bringeth forth the clouds from the ends of the world
verses.b: and sendeth forth lightnings with the rain, bringing the winds out of his treasures.

verses.a: He smote the first-born of Egypt
verses.b: both of man and beast.

verses.a: He hath sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O thou land of Egypt
verses.b: upon Pharaoh, and all his servants.

verses.a: He smote divers nations
verses.b: and slew mighty kings;

verses.a: Sehon king of the Amorites, and Og the king of Basan
verses.b: and all the kingdoms of Canaan;

verses.a: And gave their land to be an heritage
verses.b: even an heritage unto Israel his people.

verses.a: Thy Name, O Lord, endureth for ever
verses.b: so doth thy memorial, O Lord, from one generation to another.

verses.a: For the Lord will avenge his people
verses.b: and be gracious unto his servants.

verses.a: As for the images of the heathen, they are but silver and gold
verses.b: the work of men's hands.

verses.a: They have mouths, and speak not
verses.b: eyes have they, but they see not.

verses.a: They have ears, and yet they hear not
verses.b: neither is there any breath in their mouths.

verses.a: They that make them are like unto them
verses.b: and so are all they that put their trust in them.

verses.a: Praise the Lord, ye house of Israel
verses.b: praise the Lord, ye house of Aaron.

verses.a: Praise the Lord, ye house of Levi
verses.b: ye that fear the Lord, praise the Lord.

verses.a: Praised be the Lord out of Sion
verses.b: who dwelleth at Jerusalem.

verses.a: O give thanks unto the Lord, for he is gracious
verses.b: and his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.a: O give thanks unto the God of all gods
verses.b: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.a: O thank the Lord of all lords
verses.b: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.a: Who only doeth great wonders
verses.b: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.a: Who by his excellent wisdom made the heavens
verses.b: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.a: Who laid out the earth above the waters
verses.b: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.a: Who hath made great lights
verses.b: for his mercy endureth for ever;

verses.a: The sun to rule the day
verses.b: for his mercy endureth for ever;

verses.a: The moon and the stars to govern the night
verses.b: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.a: Who smote Egypt with their first-born
verses.b: for his mercy endureth for ever;

verses.a: And brought out Israel from among them
verses.b: for his mercy endureth for ever;

verses.a: With a mighty hand, and stretched out arm
verses.b: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.a: Who divided the Red sea in two parts
verses.b: for his mercy endureth for ever;

verses.a: And made Israel to go through the midst of it
verses.b: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.a: But as for Pharaoh and his host, he overthrew them in the Red sea
verses.b: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.a: Who led his people through the wilderness
verses.b: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.a: Who smote great kings
verses.b: for his mercy endureth for ever;

verses.a: Yea, and slew mighty kings
verses.b: for his mercy endureth for ever;

verses.a: Sehon king of the Amorites
verses.b: for his mercy endureth for ever;

verses.a: And Og the king of Basan
verses.b: for his mercy endureth for ever;

verses.a: And gave away their land for an heritage
verses.b: for his mercy endureth for ever;

verses.a: Even for an heritage unto Israel his servant
verses.b: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.a: Who remembered us when we were in trouble
verses.b: for his mercy endureth for ever;

verses.a: And hath delivered us from our enemies
verses.b: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.a: Who giveth food to all flesh
verses.b: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.a: O give thanks unto the God of heaven
verses.b: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.a: O give thanks unto the Lord of lords
verses.b: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.a: By the waters of Babylon we sat down and wept
verses.b: when we remembered thee, O Sion.

verses.a: As for our harps, we hanged them up
verses.b: upon the trees that are therein.

verses.a: For they that led us away captive required of us then a song, and melody in our heaviness
verses.b: Sing us one of the songs of Sion.

verses.a: How shall we sing the Lord's song
verses.b: in a strange land?

verses.a: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem
verses.b: let my right hand forget her cunning.

verses.a: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth
verses.b: yea, if I prefer not Jerusalem in my mirth.

verses.a: Remember the children of Edom, O Lord, in the day of Jerusalem
verses.b: how they said, Down with it, down with it, even to the ground.

verses.a: O daughter of Babylon , wasted with misery
verses.b: yea, happy shall he be that rewardeth thee, as thou hast served us.

verses.a: Blessed shall he be that taketh thy children
verses.b: and throweth them against the stones.

verses.a: I will give thanks unto thee, O Lord, with my whole heart
verses.b: even before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.

verses.a: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy Name, because of thy loving-kindness and truth
verses.b: for thou hast magnified thy Name and thy word above all things.

verses.a: When I called upon thee, thou heardest me
verses.b: and enduedst my soul with much strength.

verses.a: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O Lord
verses.b: for they have heard the words of thy mouth.

verses.a: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the Lord
verses.b: that great is the glory of the Lord.

verses.a: For though the Lord be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly
verses.b: as for the proud, he beholdeth them afar off.

verses.a: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, yet shalt thou refresh me
verses.b: thou shalt stretch forth thy hand upon the furiousness of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.

verses.a: The lord shall make good his loving-kindness toward me
verses.b: yea, thy mercy, O Lord, endureth for ever; despise not then the works of thine own hands.

verses.a: O Lord, thou hast searched me out and known me
verses.b: thou knowest my down-sitting and mine up-rising, thou understandest my thoughts long before.

verses.a: Thou art about my path, and about my bed
verses.b: and spiest out all my ways.

verses.a: For lo, there is not a word in my tongue
verses.b: but thou, O Lord, knowest it altogether.

verses.a: Thou hast fashioned me behind and before
verses.b: and laid thine hand upon me.

verses.a: Such knowledge is too wonderful and excellent for me
verses.b: I cannot attain unto it.

verses.a: Whither shall I go then from thy Spirit
verses.b: or whither shall I go then from thy presence?

verses.a: If I climb up into heaven, thou art there
verses.b: if I go down to hell, thou art there also.

verses.a: If I take the wings of the morning
verses.b: and remain in the uttermost parts of the sea;

verses.a: Even there also shall thy hand lead me
verses.b: and thy right hand shall hold me.

verses.a: If I say, Peradventure the darkness shall cover me
verses.b: then shall my night be turned to day.

verses.a: Yea, the darkness is no darkness with thee, but the night is as clear as the day
verses.b: the darkness and light to thee are both alike.

verses.a: For my reins are thine
verses.b: thou hast covered me in my mother's womb.

verses.a: I will give thanks unto thee, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made
verses.b: marvellous are thy works, and that my soul knoweth right well.

verses.a: My bones are not hid from thee
verses.b: though I be made secretly, and fashioned beneath in the earth.

verses.a: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect
verses.b: and in thy book were all my members written;

verses.a: Which day by day were fashioned
verses.b: when as yet there was none of them.

verses.a: How dear are thy counsels unto me, O God
verses.b: O how great is the sum of them!

verses.a: If I tell them, they are more in number than the sand
verses.b: when I wake up I am present with thee.

verses.a: Wilt thou not slay the wicked, O God
verses.b: depart from me, ye blood-thirsty men.

verses.a: For they speak unrighteously against thee
verses.b: and thine enemies take thy Name in vain.

verses.a: Do not I hate them, O Lord, that hate thee
verses.b: and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?

verses.a: Yea, I hate them right sore
verses.b: even as though they were mine enemies.

verses.a: Try me, O God, and seek the ground of my heart
verses.b: prove me, and examine my thoughts.

verses.a: Look well if there be any way of wickedness in me
verses.b: and lead me in the way everlasting.

verses.a: Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man
verses.b: and preserve me from the wicked man.

verses.a: Who imagine mischief in their hearts
verses.b: and stir up strife all the day long.

verses.a: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent
verses.b: adders' poison is under their lips.

verses.a: Keep me, O Lord, from the hands of the ungodly
verses.b: preserve me from the wicked men, who are purposed to overthrow my goings.

verses.a: The proud have laid a snare for me, and spread a net abroad with cords
verses.b: yea, and set traps in my way.

verses.a: I said unto the Lord, Thou art my God
verses.b: hear the voice of my prayers, O Lord.

verses.a: O Lord God, thou strength of my health
verses.b: thou hast covered my head in the day of the battle.

verses.a: Let not the ungodly have his desire, O Lord
verses.b: let not his mischievous imagination prosper, lest they be too proud.

verses.a: Let the mischief of their own lips fall upon the head of them
verses.b: that compass me about.

verses.a: Let hot burning coals fall upon them
verses.b: let them be cast into the fire and into the pit, that they never rise up again.

verses.a: A man full of words shall not prosper upon the earth
verses.b: evil shall hunt the wicked person to overthrow him.

verses.a: Sure I am that the Lord will avenge the poor
verses.b: and maintain the cause of the helpless.

verses.a: The righteous also shall give thanks unto thy Name
verses.b: and the just shall continue in thy sight.

verses.a: Lord, I call upon thee, haste thee unto me
verses.b: and consider my voice when I cry unto thee.

verses.a: Let my prayer be set forth in thy sight as the incense
verses.b: and let the lifting up of my hands be an evening sacrifice.

verses.a: Set a watch, O Lord, before my mouth
verses.b: and keep the door of my lips.

verses.a: O let not mine heart be inclined to any evil thing
verses.b: let me not be occupied in ungodly works with the men that work wickedness, lest I eat of such things as please them.

verses.a: Let the righteous rather smite me friendly
verses.b: and reprove me.

verses.a: But let not their precious balms break my head
verses.b: yea, I will pray yet against their wickedness.

verses.a: Let their judges be overthrown in stony places
verses.b: that they may hear my words, for they are sweet.

verses.a: Our bones lie scattered before the pit
verses.b: like as when one breaketh and heweth wood upon the earth.

verses.a: But mine eyes look unto thee, O Lord God
verses.b: in thee is my trust , O cast not out my soul.

verses.a: Keep me from the snare that they have laid for me
verses.b: and from the traps of the wicked doers.

verses.a: Let the ungodly fall into their own nets together
verses.b: and let me ever escape them.

verses.a: I cried unto the Lord with my voice
verses.b: yea, even unto the Lord did I make my supplication.

verses.a: I poured out my complaints before him
verses.b: and shewed him of my trouble.

verses.a: When my spirit was in heaviness thou knewest my path
verses.b: in the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.

verses.a: I looked also upon my right hand
verses.b: and saw there was no man that would know me.

verses.a: I had no place to flee unto
verses.b: and no man cared for my soul.

verses.a: I cried unto thee, O Lord, and said
verses.b: Thou art my hope, and my portion in the land of the living.

verses.a: Consider my complaint
verses.b: for I am brought very low.

verses.a: O deliver me from my persecutors
verses.b: for they are too strong for me.

verses.a: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks unto thy Name
verses.b: which thing if thou wilt grant me, then shall the righteous resort unto my company.

verses.a: Hear my prayer, O Lord, and consider my desire
verses.b: hearken unto me for thy truth and righteousness' sake.

verses.a: And enter not into judgement with thy servant
verses.b: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.

verses.a: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground
verses.b: he hath laid me in the darkness, as the men that have been long dead.

verses.a: Therefore is my spirit vexed within me
verses.b: and my heart within me is desolate.

verses.a: Yet do I remember the time past; I muse upon all thy works
verses.b: yea, I exercise myself in the works of thy hands.

verses.a: I stretch forth my hands unto thee
verses.b: my soul gaspeth unto thee as a thirsty land.

verses.a: Hear me, O Lord, and that soon, for my spirit waxeth faint
verses.b: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.

verses.a: O let me hear thy loving-kindness betimes in the morning, for in thee is my trust
verses.b: shew thou me the way that I should walk in, for I lift up my soul unto thee.

verses.a: Deliver me, O Lord, from mine enemies
verses.b: for I flee unto thee to hide me.

verses.a: Teach me to do the thing that pleaseth thee, for thou art my God
verses.b: let thy loving Spirit lead me forth into the land of righteousness.

verses.a: Quicken me, O Lord, for thy Name's sake
verses.b: and for thy righteousness' sake bring my soul out of trouble.

verses.a: And of thy goodness slay mine enemies
verses.b: and destroy all them that vex my soul ; for I am thy servant.

verses.a: Blessed be the Lord my strength
verses.b: who teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight;

verses.a: My hope and my fortress, my castle and deliverer, my defender in whom I trust
verses.b: who subdueth my people that is under me.

verses.a: Lord, what is man, that thou hast such respect unto him
verses.b: or the son of man, that thou so regardest him?

verses.a: Man is like a thing of nought
verses.b: his time passeth away like a shadow.

verses.a: Bow thy heavens, O Lord, and come down
verses.b: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

verses.a: Cast forth thy lightning, and tear them
verses.b: shoot out thine arrows, and consume them.

verses.a: Send down thine hand from above
verses.b: deliver me, and take me out of the great waters, from the hand of strange children;

verses.a: Whose mouth talketh of vanity
verses.b: and their right hand is a right hand of wickedness.

verses.a: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God
verses.b: and sing praises unto thee upon a ten-stringed lute.

verses.a: Thou hast given victory unto kings
verses.b: and hast delivered David thy servant from the peril of the sword.

verses.a: Save me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children
verses.b: whose mouth talketh of vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of iniquity.

verses.a: That our sons may grow up as the young plants
verses.b: and that our daughters may be as the polished corners of the temple.

verses.a: That our garners may be full and plenteous with all manner of store
verses.b: that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets.

verses.a: That our oxen may be strong to labour, that there be no decay
verses.b: no leading into captivity, and no complaining in our streets.

verses.a: Happy are the people that are in such a case
verses.b: yea, blessed are the people who have the Lord for their God.

verses.a: I will magnify thee, O God, my King
verses.b: and I will praise thy Name for ever and ever.

verses.a: Every day will I give thanks unto thee
verses.b: and praise thy Name for ever and ever.

verses.a: Great is the Lord, and marvellous worthy to be praised
verses.b: there is no end of his greatness.

verses.a: One generation shall praise thy works unto another
verses.b: and declare thy power.

verses.a: As for me, I will be talking of thy worship
verses.b: thy glory, thy praise, and wondrous works;

verses.a: So that men shall speak of the might of thy marvellous acts
verses.b: and I will also tell of thy greatness.

verses.a: The memorial of thine abundant kindness shall be shewed
verses.b: and men shall sing of thy righteousness.

verses.a: The Lord is gracious and merciful
verses.b: long-suffering and of great goodness.

verses.a: The Lord is loving unto every man
verses.b: and his mercy is over all his works.

verses.a: All thy works praise thee, O Lord
verses.b: and thy saints give thanks unto thee.

verses.a: They shew the glory of thy kingdom
verses.b: and talk of thy power;

verses.a: That thy power, thy glory, and mightiness of thy kingdom
verses.b: might be known unto men.

verses.a: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom
verses.b: and thy dominion endureth throughout all ages.

verses.a: The Lord upholdeth all such as fall
verses.b: and lifteth up all those that are down.

verses.a: The eyes of all wait upon thee, O Lord
verses.b: and thou givest them their meat in due season.

verses.a: Thou openest thine hand
verses.b: and fillest all things living with plenteousness.

verses.a: The Lord is righteous in all his ways
verses.b: and holy in all his works.

verses.a: The Lord is nigh unto all them that call upon him
verses.b: yea, all such as call upon him faithfully.

verses.a: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him
verses.b: he also will hear their cry, and will help them.

verses.a: The Lord preserveth all them that love him
verses.b: but scattereth abroad all the ungodly.

verses.a: My mouth shall speak the praise of the Lord
verses.b: and let all flesh give thanks unto his holy Name for ever and ever.

verses.a: Praise the Lord, O my soul; while I live will I praise the Lord
verses.b: yea, as long as I have any being, I will sing praises unto my God.

verses.a: O put not your trust in princes, nor in any child of man
verses.b: for there is no help in them.

verses.a: For when the breath of man goeth forth he shall turn again to his earth
verses.b: and then all his thoughts perish.

verses.a: Blessed is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help
verses.b: and whose hope is in the Lord his God;

verses.a: Who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that therein is
verses.b: who keepeth his promise for ever;

verses.a: Who helpeth them to right that suffer wrong
verses.b: who feedeth the hungry.

verses.a: The Lord looseth men out of prison
verses.b: the Lord giveth sight to the blind.

verses.a: The Lord helpeth them that are fallen
verses.b: the Lord careth for the righteous.

verses.a: The Lord careth for the strangers, he defendeth the fatherless and widow
verses.b: as for the way of the ungodly, he turneth it upside down.

verses.a: The Lord thy God, O Sion, shall be King for evermore
verses.b: and throughout all generations.

verses.a: O praise the Lord, for it is a good thing to sing praises unto our God
verses.b: yea, a joyful and pleasant thing it is to be thankful.

verses.a: The Lord doth build up Jerusalem
verses.b: and gather together the out-casts of Israel.

verses.a: He healeth those that are broken in heart
verses.b: and giveth medicine to heal their sickness.

verses.a: He telleth the number of the stars
verses.b: and calleth them all by their names.

verses.a: Great is our Lord, and great is his power
verses.b: yea, and his wisdom is infinite.

verses.a: The Lord setteth up the meek
verses.b: and bringeth the ungodly down to the ground.

verses.a: O sing unto the Lord with thanksgiving
verses.b: sing praises upon the harp unto our God;

verses.a: Who covereth the heaven with clouds, and prepareth rain for the earth
verses.b: and maketh the grass to grow upon the mountains, and herb for the use of men;

verses.a: Who giveth fodder unto the cattle
verses.b: and feedeth the young ravens that call upon him.

verses.a: He hath no pleasure in the strength of an horse
verses.b: neither delighteth he in any man's legs.

verses.a: But the Lord's delight is in them that fear him
verses.b: and put their trust in his mercy.

verses.a: Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem
verses.b: praise thy God, O Sion.

verses.a: For he hath made fast the bars of thy gates
verses.b: and hath blessed thy children within thee.

verses.a: He maketh peace in thy borders
verses.b: and filleth thee with the flour of wheat.

verses.a: He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth
verses.b: and his word runneth very swiftly.

verses.a: He giveth snow like wool
verses.b: and scattereth the hoar-frost like ashes.

verses.a: He casteth forth his ice like morsels
verses.b: who is able to abide his frost?

verses.a: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them
verses.b: he bloweth with his wind, and the waters flow.

verses.a: He sheweth his word unto Jacob
verses.b: his statutes and ordinances unto Israel.

verses.a: He hath not dealt so with any nation
verses.b: neither have the heathen knowledge of his laws.

verses.a: O praise the Lord of heaven
verses.b: praise him in the height.

verses.a: Praise him, all ye angels of his
verses.b: praise him, all his host.

verses.a: Praise him, sun and moon
verses.b: praise him, all ye stars and light.

verses.a: Praise him, all ye heavens
verses.b: and ye waters that are above the heavens.

verses.a: Let them praise the Name of the Lord
verses.b: for he spake the word, and they were made; he commanded, and they were created.

verses.a: He hath made them fast for ever and ever
verses.b: he hath given them a law which shall not be broken.

verses.a: Praise the Lord upon earth
verses.b: ye dragons, and all deeps;

verses.a: Fire and hail, snow and vapours
verses.b: wind and storm, fulfilling his word;

verses.a: Mountains and all hills
verses.b: fruitful trees and all cedars;

verses.a: Beasts and all cattle
verses.b: worms and feathered fowls;

verses.a: Kings of the earth and all people
verses.b: princes and all judges of the world;

verses.a: Young men and maidens, old men and children, praise the Name of the Lord
verses.b: for his Name only is excellent, and his praise above heaven and earth.

verses.a: He shall exalt the horn of his people; all his saints shall praise him
verses.b: even the children of Israel, even the people that serveth him.

verses.a: O sing unto the Lord a new song
verses.b: let the congregation of saints praise him.

verses.a: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him
verses.b: and let the children of Sion be joyful in their King.

verses.a: Let them praise his Name in the dance
verses.b: let them sing praises unto him with tabret and harp.

verses.a: For the Lord hath pleasure in his people
verses.b: and helpeth the meek-hearted.

verses.a: Let the saints be joyful with glory
verses.b: let them rejoice in their beds.

verses.a: Let the praises of God be in their mouth
verses.b: and a two-edged sword in their hands;

verses.a: To be avenged of the heathen
verses.b: and to rebuke the people;

verses.a: To bind their kings in chains
verses.b: and their nobles with links of iron.

verses.a: That they may be avenged of them, as it is written
verses.b: Such honour have all his saints.

verses.a: O praise God in his holiness
verses.b: praise him in the firmament of his power.

verses.a: Praise him in his noble acts
verses.b: praise him according to his excellent greatness.

verses.a: Praise him in the sound of the trumpet
verses.b: praise him upon the lute and harp.

verses.a: Praise him in the cymbals and dances
verses.b: praise him upon the strings and pipe.

verses.a: Praise him upon the well-tuned cymbals
verses.b: praise him upon the loud cymbals.

verses.a: Let every thing that hath breath
verses.b: praise the Lord.
